subject: Feasibility check: isolated-hosting integration + ops staffing clarifications
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecloud.com>, GreenShore Ops <ops@greenshore.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick feasibility check — isolated hosting integration + ops staffing clarifications

Hi all,

Following the GreenShore kickoff yesterday, they asked for a concise feasibility summary that covers both architecture constraints and the operational staffing we'd need to support an isolated on-prem/VPC deployment (their compliance team is tight on separation). I attached a draft capacity estimate and a rough architecture sketch.

Two asks from product/eng/ops so we can surface a single ask to Sales/Customer:
- Can infra confirm the minimal runtime topology we can promise (single-region redundant, or must be multi-region for HA)? Specific ask: list of services that must be dedicated vs. sharable.
- Ops: what ongoing headcount / oncall commitments do we need for an enterprise isolated pilot (3-month pilot, expected 50k tokens/day average)?

Please respond with short bullets where possible. If you need more context from GreenShore, Sam (cc) can provide their SOC/architecture requirements.

Attachments: [Attachment: capacity-estimate-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)], [Attachment: arch-sketch.png (png, 80KB)]

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecloud.com>, GreenShore Ops <ops@greenshore.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick feasibility check — isolated hosting integration + ops staffing clarifications

On Mon, Nov 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com> wrote:
> Following the GreenShore kickoff yesterday, they asked for a concise feasibility summary that covers both architecture constraints and the operational staffing we'd need to support an isolated on-prem/VPC deployment...

Short answers up front:
- Minimal runtime topology: single-region with active-passive redundancy is feasible for a pilot. Multi-region HA is possible but requires additional networking (private cross-region tunnels) and doubles the ops surface.
- Dedicated vs shared: model serving (GPU pools), KV cache, and any HSM/KMS endpoints must be dedicated. Control plane components (for pilot) can be shared if network isolation and strong tenant authorization are enforced — but GreenShore's compliance note may push us to dedicate the control plane.

Follow-up questions I need to size impact:
1) Expected peak concurrent streams (not daily tokens) — this drives GPU pool sizing.
2) Acceptable RTO/RPO for the pilot.
3) Is GreenShore prepared to host a customer-managed KMS/HSM, or must we provide managed keys inside their VPC?

I'll attach a short tech delta list (will send in next message) — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Architect, Serving Runtime
marcus@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecloud.com>, GreenShore Ops <ops@greenshore.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T13:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick feasibility check — isolated hosting integration + ops staffing clarifications

Thanks Priya / Marcus. Putting the ask in ops terms so we can get a decision quickly:

Operational commitments for a 3-month pilot (50k tokens/day average, bursty daytime traffic):
- Dedicated SRE on-call: 1 FTE dedicated to pilot (primary), 0.5 FTE backup (shared across pilots) — on-call rotation 1:2.
- Deployment support during rollout (first 2 weeks): Eng runbook handoff + 3 days of embedded on-call from Serving Runtime team.
- Monthly capacity review + token-cost reconciliation: 0.2 FTE from Finance/CostOps.
- Compliance evidence & audits: 0.3 FTE + SOC2 mapping assistance (we'll need to fill gaps in their questionnaire).

Decision requested by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-18):
- Whether Sales should escalate for a Dedicated control plane (higher price) or propose a Shared-control-plane + strict network isolation (lower price).
- Confirm whether GreenShore will provide a customer-managed KMS (preferred) or we need to support managed keys inside their VPC.

Notes: see attached soc2-mapping-request.pdf for the evidence items they asked for.
Attachments: [Attachment: soc2-mapping-request.pdf (pdf, 90KB)]

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmecloud.com>

Date: 2026-11-15T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick feasibility check — isolated hosting integration + ops staffing clarifications

Thanks everyone — quick clarifications from GreenShore Ops (copied):
- Peak concurrent streams: 45 during business hours, plus nightly batch windows for analytics (these are non-latency sensitive).
- KMS: GreenShore prefers customer-managed keys inside their HSM; procurement is already clearing that path.
- RTO: target 30 minutes for service failover during pilot, RPO 15 minutes for critical logs.

They can provide SOC artifacts for review; I'll upload a zipped bundle to the drive link shortly. For the control plane, compliance would prefer dedicated control-plane for pilot, but they are open to a justified exception if we can provide strong network-level attestations.

Next step from my side: I'll schedule a 30-min engineering sync tomorrow 10am PT to walk the tech delta list and have Marcus confirm GPU sizing assumptions.

Regards,
Sam Lee
